feature: Playable ClassicUO dream room before original U7 arrival
architecture: Separate client World rendered by GameScene and stock map/render lists
Ordinary UO surfaces, walls, bed, player and moongate
Guardian texture is a world item with world depth, original blue palette cycle and transparent mouths
Normal UO collision, movement interpolation, turning, arrow keys and mouse-distance running
U7 native BEGIN remains held until the player steps onto portal tile
Escape wakes only; no automatic movement in normal play; existing saves bypass room
limits: Interim clay animation retains the previously accepted pose limitations
Small adapted dream room, not a reconstruction of the original Earth bedroom
The native U7 save begins at Trinsic; dream progress is client-only
parallel_work: Shared rendering files staged with only dream-specific hunks; other asset and rendering changes excluded
